newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Arab-Malaysian says exposure to property not high.
newsitem.headline: Arab-Malaysian says exposure to property not high.

text.p: The Arab-Malaysian group said on Tuesday that the exposure of the group's companies to the property and share financing sectors was not very high.
"We wish to inform that in respect of Group's exposure to share financing, we are well within the limit stipulated by Bank Negara Malaysia," it said in a statement.
Bank Negara has limited loans for purchase of shares to 15 percent of total loan outstandings.
It said the exposure of some of its companies to the property sector was marginally higher than the limit of 20 percent of total loan outstandings set by Bank Negara.
Arab-Malaysian Finance Bhd's exposure to property was 18.2 percent of total loan outstandings, Arab Malaysian Merchant Bank Bhd 25.4 percent and Arab-Malaysian Bank Bhd 20.5 percent.
Bank Negara introduced the curbs last month to prevent high levels of speculation in the property and share sectors.
